title: Barpeta
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Barpeta is a town in western Assam, famous for its Vaishnavite satra and for Doul Utsav, the spring Holi festival celebrated with colour, music and dance.

Barpeta Satra

Barpeta Satra, founded in the 16th century in the Sankardev tradition, is one of Assam's most important satras. Its kirtan ghar (prayer hall) and its festivals draw devotees from across the state.

Doul Utsav

Doul Utsav, held around Holi, features holi geet (songs), dance and the throwing of coloured powder, and is one of Assam's most colourful public festivals.
